notes: Agent successfully implemented the user board with all acceptance criteria verified and passing (FLIP 0.93). Comprehensive feature set includes session persistence, CLI interface, event integration, and write functionality. Implementation was fast (~2 min) and well-structured for downstream consumption. Primary concern: yellow coredrift warnings (dependency_drift, hardening_in_core) appeared 3 times during development but were not explicitly addressed. The system recommended confirming intentionality or reverting; agent proceeded to completion without addressing this flag. While the verification results show functional correctness and no errors, the unaddressed coredrift warnings suggest potential architectural or convention violations that should have been reconciled. Also minor coordination overhead from initial task orphaning. Overall solid execution with strong results but incomplete adherence to system feedback.
